_doc: Vibe score levels. Edit names and texts freely; keep 5 bands. No em dashes, sentence case. Colours are the level inks, also used as the mascot body fill: red, orange, then a deeper yellow, Diagnose blue, Fix green.

levels.name: Prompt roulette
levels.text: Sometimes it works, mostly it doesn't, and you pay for every spin. Sessions that never end, caches that go cold over lunch, a novel's worth of context on every call. Good news: nobody has cheaper fixes than you.

levels.name: Token bonfire
levels.text: Things get built, and a lot of tokens go up in smoke on the way. Most of your spend carries old context around instead of doing new work. A few habits turn this bonfire into a campfire.

levels.name: Agent wrangler
levels.text: You know your way around the agent, and it mostly knows its way around you. A couple of leaks still cost real money every week. Patch them and you're a level up.

levels.name: Claude whisperer
levels.text: Lean sessions, warm caches, few retries. You're ahead of most developers. What's left is fine-tuning: model routing and the odd marathon session.

levels.name: AI superfactory
levels.text: Short sessions, the right model for each job, almost nothing wasted. Your agents run like a well-oiled factory. Frame this and send it to your team lead.
